title: ISHNE Holter toolbox
summary: Read and write ISHNE Holter ECG signal files.
description: A toolbox that owns the ISHNE Holter ECG binary format and returns a domain-free struct. Read and write signals, inspect and validate headers (with a CRC-CCITT checksum), select leads, crop a window, and work from bytes in memory. Designed to be a dependency of higher-level toolboxes such as ecglab.
